blogs.title: The Geometry of Finetuning: Why Orthogonality Matters
blogs.description: This post explores the core motivation behind Orthogonal Finetuning (OFT), explaining how preserving the geometric relationships (pairwise angles) between neurons helps retain pretraining knowledge. It breaks down why a multiplicative orthogonal approach offers better stability than standard additive methods.

blogs.title: From Fast Fourier Transforms to Better AI: The Butterfly Effect
blogs.description: A deep dive into the technical innovation behind BOFT. This post explains how the researchers borrowed the 'butterfly' structure from the classic Cooley-Tukey FFT algorithm to drastically reduce the number of trainable parameters from O(d^2) to O(d log d) without sacrificing model expressivity.

blogs.title: Outperforming LoRA: A New Benchmark for Parameter-Efficient Finetuning
blogs.description: A comparative analysis between the proposed BOFT method and the industry standard, LoRA. The article breaks down the differences between low-rank updates and orthogonal updates, showcasing empirical results where BOFT outperforms current state-of-the-art methods across Large Language Models and Vision Transformers.

blogs.title: Visualizing Neural Networks as Information Highways
blogs.description: This post discusses the paper's novel framework for understanding matrix factorization as an information transmission problem. It uses accessible analogies—like data flowing through a network grid—to explain how sparse matrix connections can construct dense, powerful transformations efficiently.
